### Abraham’s Visitor
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-6-2025.html
Passage: Genesis 18:1
Points:
- God gave Abraham an extraordinary covenant promise without providing an explicit timeline.
- Trusting God grew increasingly difficult for Abraham and Sarah as decades passed without a child.
- When three visitors arrived, Abraham recognized one of them as a pre-incarnate appearance of Jesus.
- The Lord visited in person to encourage the couple to wait patiently on His perfect timing.

### They Ate
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/they-ate
Passage: Genesis 18:8
Points:
- Abraham served his unexpected guests a lavish meal of fine bread, dairy, and choice calf meat.
- The high quality of the food unknowingly foreshadowed pure offerings suitable for the Lord.
- In the biblical world, sharing a meal established intimate fellowship and affirmed covenant peace.
- God's willingness to eat with Abraham demonstrated the close communion between the Lord and His servant.
- This divine fellowship points forward to the communion believers share with Christ in the Lord's Supper.
